items.title: Kolibri: A Sovereign Open-Weight Model
items.summary: Kolibri is an English-German Mixture-of-Experts model with 78B total and 3B active parameters, a context of up to 1M tokens and open weights under Apache 2.0, specialized for sovereign, mission-critical work.
items.titleZh: Kolibri：一款主权开放权重模型
items.summaryZh: Kolibri 是一款英语—德语混合专家模型，总参数量为 780 亿、激活参数量为 30 亿，上下文长度最高可达 100 万 token，并以 Apache 2.0 许可开放权重，专为主权需求和关键任务打造。

items.title: Apple says it’s tightening macOS ‘Full Disk Access’ controls due to new risks from AI agents
items.summary: Apple says it will add new controls around macOS’s Full Disk Access permission, warning that increasingly capable AI agents make broad access to users’ files, messages, mail, and browsing history riskier.
items.titleZh: Apple 称将收紧 macOS“完全磁盘访问”权限控制，应对 AI 智能体带来的新风险
items.summaryZh: Apple 表示，将为 macOS 的“完全磁盘访问”权限增加新的控制措施，并警告称，能力日益增强的 AI 智能体若广泛访问用户的文件、消息、邮件和浏览记录，风险也会随之上升。

items.title: Federal judge calls Flock ‘indiscriminate mass surveillance’
items.summary: A federal judge ruled that a sheriff’s deputy violated a woman’s Fourth Amendment rights when using Flock to search for her license plate without a warrant.
items.titleZh: 联邦法官称 Flock 属于“无差别大规模监控”
items.summaryZh: 一名联邦法官裁定，一名警长办公室副警长在没有搜查令的情况下使用 Flock 搜查一名女性的车牌，侵犯了她的《第四修正案》权利。
